non_error_states: authorized recovery with proposals still pending
rules: Routes and command leaves reference canonical_errors or inherited LLD-01 codes only.
Compatibility aliases exist for older design/test wording and must not be emitted by new transport code.
Raw persistence/framework/parser exceptions are never machine-visible contracts; they map to bounded codes and sanitized diagnostics.
Row-level warnings/errors never silently acquire domain authority or force unrelated safe scopes to fail unless workbook-level integrity prevents isolation.
